tr-cabinet-table.credit_line: Theodore Roosevelt's cabinet in session, photographed by Underwood & Underwood, probably 2 March 1909 - Roosevelt at the left, with George B. Cortelyou, Charles Bonaparte, Truman H. Newberry, James Wilson, Oscar Straus and James R. Garfield among those at the table. Mount and studio copyright line cropped away. Theodore Roosevelt Collection, Houghton Library, Harvard University.
